description: This file implements the PermissionService interface for managing user permissions within the system. It provides methods for retrieving, saving, deleting, and modifying permissions, particularly in relation to user groups.

classes.name: PermissionServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the PermissionService interface, managing user permissions, extending generic entity service, annotated as a Spring Service.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a Permission entity by its identifier.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves or updates a Permission entity (method not yet implemented).

methods.name: deletePermission
methods.description: Deletes a Permission, ensuring it is retrieved fresh and disassociates it from groups before deletion.

methods.name: getPermissions
methods.description: Fetches a list of Permissions associated with provided group IDs.

methods.name: listByCriteria
methods.description: Lists permissions based on specified criteria.

methods.name: removePermission
methods.description: Removes a specific Group from a Permission's group associations.

methods.name: listPermission
methods.description: Returns a list of all permissions.
